rule: Requirements only. Actual current implementation and acceptance remain in docs/CURRENT_STAGE.md.

identity.asset: Explicit authorized NAS original identity and version
identity.presentation: Official Memoh Vue components, native locale and centralized UI theme

required_now.server: Memoh native user authentication and sessions
required_now.client: Official Vue login, protected credentials and cold reopening
required_now.accept: Keep the native Bot/session identity and existing history; no second authentication adapter.

required_now.server: Memoh native Bots and sessions
required_now.client: Official Bot selection and session list
required_now.accept: Users can talk directly to the selected Bot; one NAS Bot is the supervisor.

required_now.server: Memoh native Bot identity and persistent session
required_now.client: Send directly to the selected native session
required_now.accept: No supervisor approval or relay is added to ordinary messages; sessions remain isolated.

required_now.server: Native conversation and explicit attachment references
required_now.client: Preserve native references with the composed text
required_now.accept: Only explicitly authorized task inputs are handed off; an attachment ID is not an authorization grant.

required_now.server: NAS original ready/integrity before the native send
required_now.client: Official editable composer preserves text, selection, references and attachments
required_now.accept: One explicit mixed send; failed or cancelled preparation sends nothing; duplicate ready or retries do not resubmit.

required_now.server: NAS original and native attachment identity
required_now.client: Same-App direct transfer with real cancellation/reopening behavior
required_now.accept: Do not invent completion, background persistence or recovery; do not reissue an unknown business effect.

required_now.server: Actual transferred bytes and confirmed total
required_now.client: Existing controls express measured transfer progress
required_now.accept: Multipart wire progress is identified as wire bytes; no estimated file-byte or completion claim.

required_now.server: One NAS original, full byte-size and SHA verification
required_now.client: Hand exact verified original references to the native send path
required_now.accept: Current and explicitly referenced attachments must be ready before the corresponding model turn.

required_now.server: Native Bot authorization and task scope
required_now.client: Authenticated original preview, download and playback
required_now.accept: Canonical identity locates bytes; it does not replace authorization, versioning or task-scope acceptance.

required_now.server: Authenticated verified original content
required_now.client: Official image gallery with continuous fullscreen zoom and system preset actions
required_now.accept: Normal image viewing has no permanent toolbar; long press uses native save/share affordances.

required_now.server: Memoh native authorized media tools
required_now.client: Retain the selected original and explicit references
required_now.accept: Only authorized task input is read; no invented private reasoning or image quota.

required_now.server: The exact captured recording becomes a NAS attachment before native send
required_now.client: Hold Mic, same-source transcription and shared mature waveform playback
required_now.accept: Release feedback precedes native finalization; preserve the real handle, waveform, duration and mixed snapshot. Silent/failed transcription does not append an audio fallback.

required_now.server: Authorized Windows/external derivation returns to NAS before model input
required_now.client: Correct original/conversion and MIME selection
required_now.accept: State actual temporal/audio-visual coverage and information loss; images do not prove video understanding.

required_now.server: Authorized complete content
required_now.client: Mature image, audio and video playback/seek
required_now.accept: Actual content, playback/seek and physical device observation are separate checks.

required_now.server: Memoh native model/runtime configuration through the authorized NAS gateway
required_now.client: Official independent configuration controls
required_now.accept: Persist the latest thinking/search combination without mutually disabling controls; no global second Agent pipeline.

required_now.server: Memoh native inference, tools, persistent session and memory integration
required_now.client: Official native reply, rich content and public reasoning presentation
required_now.accept: No replacement inference/memory core; live reasoning expands in page flow and finishes collapsed.

required_now.server: Native execution status and explicit task identity
required_now.client: Reopening and errors preserve the original request/result
required_now.accept: Unknown outcomes are not retried on another resource; no new grant ledger or dispatch service.

required_now.server: NAS-authorized business state and registered results
required_now.client: System picker/recording, local grants, save/share and subsequent notification adaptation
required_now.accept: Phone does not host an Agent; Windows receives authorized computation input only; no heavy NAS fallback.

required_now.server: Centralized theme configuration and native preferences
required_now.client: Official light, dark, warm and system theme controls
required_now.accept: Preserve the selected theme across reopening; static selection is separate from measured OS following.

required_now.server: Results return to NAS and pass registration/integrity before delivery
required_now.client: Same-App original viewing, system saving and cold reopening
required_now.accept: Reuse the exact completed result; do not rerun Windows or model tasks to verify viewing.

planned_not_implemented.constraint: Corresponding phone/NAS albums, memberships and content converge in both directions with phone writeback; deferred until usable transfer foundations. Not implemented by one-way upload.

planned_not_implemented.owner: Memoh native memory provider on NAS
planned_not_implemented.constraint: Stage 4: separately verify authorized write, cross-session recall, correction and deletion with new synthetic input.
Stable task identity, real lifecycle, continuation and cancel; native capabilities are not considered connected until actually verified.
Arbitrary file types, batch mixed input, original roundtrip, recovery, single inventory and space reclamation remain required.
Ordinary computation runs programs directly; phone never holds maintenance/admin credentials.

planned_not_implemented.owner: Authorized NAS model outlet and qualified external/Windows capability
planned_not_implemented.constraint: Generated results join the same NAS registration, authorization, integrity and original saving path.

planned_not_implemented.owner: Memoh native Bot/task authorization and NAS file management
planned_not_implemented.constraint: Native Bot/session/task/attachment/version references remain explicit; shared paths do not grant access.

planned_not_implemented.owner: Native authorized tools and file references
planned_not_implemented.constraint: Preserve spreadsheet/document processing and follow-up modification requirements without inventing another chat protocol.
Public/mobile networking, notification and daily recovery/performance remain deferred; no new home-network entry is opened.

planned_not_implemented.owner: Shared official frontend and Android platform adapter
planned_not_implemented.constraint: Android and natural assistant integration remain required; platform-specific APIs are not claimed portable.
